:::{#def-reed-solomon-code}
#### Reed--Solomon code

Let $\mathbb{F}_q$ be a finite field, let $k \le n \le q$,
and fix $n$ distinct points $a_1, \ldots, a_n \in \mathbb{F}_q$.
The **Reed--Solomon code** sends a message
$m = (m_0, \ldots, m_{k-1}) \in \mathbb{F}_q^k$
to the values of the polynomial
$f_m(t) \eqdef m_0 + m_1 t + \cdots + m_{k-1} t^{k-1}$
at the $n$ points:

$$E(m) \eqdef \bigl(f_m(a_1), \ldots, f_m(a_n)\bigr).$$

@reed1960polynomial introduced these codes.

:::
